column6: Running, aeroplane style: both arms raised as wings – tilting from side to side
Running, akimbo style: hands on hips
Running, angry style: swing lower arms aggressively - fists closed
Running, arms above head style: arms raised straight above head
Running, arms behind back style: hands clasped behind back
Running, arms by side style: keep arms fixed by side and do not move them
Running, arms folded style: right arm folded over left
Running, balance style: arms out to side for balance - tilting side to side
Running, beat chest style: beat chest while moving normally
Running, bent forward style: tilt torso forwards
Running, bent knees style: bend knees as much as possible
Running, big steps style: as large steps as possible
Running, bouncy left style: step normally with right foot but spring off left foot
Running, bouncy right style: step normally with left foot but spring off right foot
Running, cat style: use hands as paws - step opposite hand and foot
Running, chicken style: bob head - arms as wings
Running, cross over style: step each foot in front of other leg
Running, crouched style: squat slightly and bend back
Running, crowd avoidance style: occasionally turning shoulders or turn sideways to avoid others
Running, depressed style: head bowed arms swinging
Running, dinosaur style: like a t-rex arms close to body dinosaur posture
Running, drag left leg style: drag left foot along the floor
Running, drag right leg style: drag right foot along the floor
Running, drunk style: stumbling around at random. Various foot step sizes and arm motions
Running, duck foot style: toes pointing inwards
Running, elated style: swing arms with spring
Running, fairy steps style: one foot in front of the other so the heel touches the toe
Running, flapping style: flap arms as wings on tiptoes
Running, flick legs style: knees together and flick legs to sides as moving
Running, followed style: check behind occasionally
Running, graceful arms style: one arm across chest the other extended walk tall
Running, hands between legs style: bent back – legs wide - hands swing between legs
Running, hands in pockets style: place hands in pockets and walk and run
Running, heavyset style: walking as a muscle man tensed biceps
Running, high knees style: lift knees high but only knees – not marching
Running, in the dark style: feeling around as if in darkness
Running, karate chop style
Running, kick style: kick with every step
Running, lawn mower style: roll hands over one another like disco move and tilt torso forwards and then back
Running, lean back style: bent backwards
Running, lean left style: normal motion upperbody tilted right
Running, lean right style: normal motion upperbody tilted left
Running, left hop style: hop on left foot
Running, legs apart style: legs relatively straight wide apart
Running, limp left style: keep left leg straight and limp
Running, limp right style: keep right leg straight and limp
Running, look up style: tilt head to look at ceiling
Running, lunge style: wide step bend knee every step in lunge position
Running, march style: high knees swing arms at elbows
Running, monk style: interlock hands in front of pelvis head slightly bowed
Running, morris style: swing hands side to side as if waving hankies
Running, neutral style: normal walking
Running, old style: hunchbacked move very slowly
Running, on heels style: walk on heels with toes raised
Running, on phone left style: holding phone in left
Running, on phone right style: holding phone in right
Running, on toes bent forward style: as bent forward style but on tip toes
Running, on toes crouched style
Running, pendulum hands style: squat slightly make right angle with elbows and swing hands freely
Running, penguin style: waddle with feet close together
Running, pigeon toed style: toes turned inwards
Running, proud style: straight back arms move as if marching to a lesser degree
Running, punch style: punch with every step
Running, quail style: arms straight by sides slightly back very small quick steps
Running, raised left arm style: raise left arm perpendicular to body
Running, raised right arm style: raise right arm perpendicular to body
Running, right hop style: hop on right foot
Running, roadrunner style: arms behind as wings pick up knees - bent a little
Running, robot style: stiff movements arms bending at elbows
Running, rocket style: bent to flat back with hands behind as thrusters
Running, rushed style: rushing about swinging arms for extra momentum
Running, shielded left style
Running, shielded right style
Running, skip style: skipping like a child
Running, slide feet style: barely lift feet off the floor/kick into floor
Running, star style: wide arms and legs. Arms slightly below horizontal
Running, start stop style: pause briefly after step
Running, stiff style: stiff limbs arms straight
Running, strutting style: with swagger leant slightly back arms swinging freely
Running, superman style: right arm raised like superman flying
Running, swat style: as if holding a rifle and raiding a building
Running, sweep style: sweeping with a broom while moving
Running, swimming style: breaststroke walking
Running, swing arms round style
Running, swing shoulders style: rotate torso and shoulders left to right and back
Running, teapot style: one arm on hip other arm raised
Running, tiptoe style: walk on toes with heels raised
Running, together step style: step left foot - then together – then right foot
Running, two foot jump style: feet together and jump
Running, walking stick left style: walk with a stick – used broom handle
Running, walking stick right style: walk with a stick – used broom handle
Running, waving style: waving at somebody else at random
Running, whirl arms style: windmill arms
Running, wide legs style: legs apart motions
Running, wiggle hips style: hands raised in front of body wiggle hips side to side
Running, wild arms style: swing arms much more than normal almost punching into the air
Running, wild legs style: kick legs into the air with each step
Running, zombie style: arms in front like zombie
